shortDescription: Manage DS8000 volume mapping to hosts

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the DS8000 storage system HMC.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the DS8000 host to work with.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the DS8000 storage system I(username).

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the DS8000 storage system HMC.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify the state the DS8000 volume mapping should be in.

options.name: username
options.description: The username for the DS8000 storage system.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Controls validation of SSL chain of trust. Set to C(no) to allow connection when SSL certificates are not trusted.

options.name: volume_id
options.description: The volume ID of the volume that you want to map to a host.

options.name: volume_name
options.description: The volume name that you want to map to a host. Notice that different volumes sometimes have the same volume name, so it will map all of them. To use a specific volume, use I(volume_id)
